items.title: Does Earnings Beat Change The Bull Case For Cencora (COR)?
items.summary: Cencora reported fiscal Q4 2026 sales of US$88.35b and net income of US$519.4m, with full year earnings rising to US$3.48b, and increased its quarterly dividend to US$0.66 per share payable on 30 November 2026. The sharp shift from a prior year quarterly net loss to profit, combined with a higher dividend and new segment reporting, gives investors clearer visibility into how specialty services and acquisitions such as OneOncology contribute to Cencora's earnings profile.
